description: Vertical (9:16) title-card shot of cyclists in neon-yellow helmets crossing Duluth's teal Aerial Lift Bridge, overlaid with bold white serif text reading 'Why come to NORC?'.
notable_details: Single static take (12.4s) used as a promotional teaser/hook opener; same underlying footage as the opening shot of Social 1.mov (asset 7d1af65757a5, shot 0), repurposed here with an added question-prompt title card, suggesting this clip is a short-form promo/recruitment video for the conference.
